feed_title: Sherpa High Sided Nest Dog Bed, Cushioned Base, Removable Zipped Cover, Small 50 x 40cm to Large 71 x 58cm | PawLunova Windermere
descriptionHtml:
Sherpa lining. High sides all round. 50 × 40cm to 71 × 58cm.

Windermere is a sherpa lined high sided nest dog bed with a cushioned base, in Small 50 × 40cm, Medium 58 × 48cm and Large 71 × 58cm. The zipped cover is removable.

They wedge themselves into the corner of the sofa and sleep with a spine against the back of it. That is not awkwardness. Plenty of dogs only switch off with something solid along one side.

High sides run round every edge here, so whichever way they face there is something behind them, and the sherpa holds warmth in a room gone cold by ten.

What they get

  • High sides all round: A surround on every edge rather than a single bolster at the back.
  • Sherpa lining: A fleece-like surface that keeps warmth where they settle.
  • A cushioned base: Filled rather than foamed, so it gives as they drop into it.
  • A removable zipped cover: It comes off and is washed to its own sewn-in instructions.
  • Three sizes: 50 × 40cm, 58 × 48cm and 71 × 58cm on the outside.

Best for: Curled-up dogs who press against a side, cold rooms and draughty hallways.

Why it is worth the money

Small is £69, Medium £89 and Large £119. What you buy is enclosure and warmth. Sides on all four edges, sherpa where they lie, in a middle size band rather than a giant one. Set against our sherpa bed with a raised rim, this is the more enclosed. If they have not settled across 100 nights, it goes back.

Sides on every edge means there is no open front. Every route in is over an edge, and a dog who has stopped lifting their back legs high will notice that.

Size and fit

SizeListed dimensions (cm)
Small50 × 40
Medium58 × 48
Large71 × 58

Those are outside figures, and high sides on four edges take a real share of them. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly which one to take.

Everyday care

Remove the cover and follow its sewn-in washing instructions. Air-dry fully before refitting.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

The questions we get asked most

Small, Medium or Large?

Curled-up length plus 15 to 20cm, held against the inside of the sides.

How much will delivery add?

Nothing above £40, and your window is shown on the shipping page.

Can I pay in instalments?

Yes, through the options offered at the checkout stage.

Is there a low side to step over?

No. The sides run right round, which makes it enclosed and a climb.

Is it suitable for a dog with dodgy hips?

Whether a struggling dog should climb a side at all is for your vet.

Can I actually wash it?

The cover unzips and washes to whatever its label allows.

And if she sleeps on the floor instead?

Tell us inside 100 nights and we take it away again.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.
